source.method: Deterministic repack of imagegen-derived V29 cardinal source cells and V30 diagonal source cells into one neutral white/gray 8-direction POT atlas. Fire frames are remapped to clean aim/firing poses per direction to avoid inherited generated fragment cells. No source docs or lane task files modified. No baked faction colors.

runtime_tint_contract.base_draw: neutral white/gray body_shadow_pot for all soldiers; no baked faction colors
runtime_tint_contract.mask_draw: optional technical mask atlas has identical frame rects, pivots, UVs, and sequence order if PM/user later requires faction mask tinting
runtime_tint_contract.do_not_tint: Do not tint the whole body atlas; do not bind colored preview art.
runtime_tint_contract.user_visual_direction: one neutral white/gray soldier atlas only; no blue/red/all-color presentation
